children: Chesapeake Utilities formed a joint venture for the Florida Energy Pathway project with NextEra Energy Resources taking a 49% stake and Chesapeake retaining 51%, under an amended and restated LLC agreement. The partners also executed a Construction, Operation and Management Agreement appointing Chesapeake’s Peninsula Pipeline Company as Operator. To support funding, Chesapeake provided an approximately $109 million guaranty and NextEra Energy Capital added an approximately $105 million guaranty, each with a minimum performance assurance tied to a $50 million pool. The agreements aim to co-develop, finance, and operate a natural gas transmission project serving South Florida.
